description: Implementation of thread identity creation and management functions for Abseil synchronization internal, including thread identity reuse, cleanup, and initialization.

classes.name: base_internal::ThreadIdentity
classes.description: Represents thread-specific identity data used internally for synchronization.

methods.name: ReclaimThreadIdentity
methods.description: Destructor for reclaiming ThreadIdentity objects, freeing resources, and returning the object to a freelist.

methods.name: RoundUp
methods.description: Rounds an address up to the next multiple of the specified alignment.

methods.name: OneTimeInitThreadIdentity
methods.description: Initializes a ThreadIdentity object with necessary setup.

methods.name: ResetThreadIdentityBetweenReuse
methods.description: Resets a ThreadIdentity object to a clean state for reuse.

methods.name: NewThreadIdentity
methods.description: Creates a new ThreadIdentity object, reusing from freelist if possible, or allocating new memory.

methods.name: CreateThreadIdentity
methods.description: Allocates and attaches a ThreadIdentity to the current thread, setting up cleanup destructor.
